  • People pestering users who downvote them
  • A net decrease in privacy with little tangible benefit
  • Companies able to build profiles on user interests based on their public voting record
  • Users will use downvote history to try to discredit users they disagree with ("well who are you to talk, you just go around downvoting X")
  • It would cause a chilling effect on users who don't want their private opinions to be made public

  • If you have not fallen asleep after 20 minutes get up and do something else (have a glass of water/read a magazine etc)

  • Your bedroom needs to be really dark and quiet

  • Do not watch tv or use your computer/mobile/tablet etc right before bed

  • Keep a low temperature in your bedroom 18-19 degrees Celsius

  • Do not drink or eat anything containing caffeine less then 5 hours before bedtime

  • Do not go to bed until you are really tired

  • Try green tea, chamomile tea or any other supplements that might work (valerina night for instance)
